inspiration.observed_pattern: A reusable integer sequence joins each JSON document up to JSON_LENGTH and builds an array-element path for JSON_EXTRACT from the sequence value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one two-element order array and two sequence values so the bounded join and zero-based dynamic JSON paths remain observable.

fixture_notes: One order has two items and the sequence has two values, producing both indexed rows.
determinism_notes: Sequence values, JSON array order, path construction, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE order_payloads (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE item_sequence (seq_no INT PRIMARY KEY)

steps.sql: SELECT o.order_id, s.seq_no, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload, CONCAT('$.items[', s.seq_no - 1, '].sku'))) AS sku, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload, CONCAT('$.items[', s.seq_no - 1, '].qty'))) AS UNSIGNED) AS quantity FROM order_payloads AS o JOIN item_sequence AS s ON s.seq_no <= JSON_LENGTH(o.payload, '$.items') ORDER BY o.order_id, s.seq_no
